note_quote.quote: No named exception approved for Alder Bank

findings.reason: The BioCatch behavioural connector is in beta and requires a named approval, but the pricing note records no approved named exception for Alder Bank, so this cannot yet be sold as promised.

findings.commitment: Hosting of Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will host Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

findings.reason: Elva's regional cloud deployment capability only supports AWS and GCP in Australia; Azure is not an offered cloud and cannot be approved as an exception.

findings.commitment: Hosting cloud provider for Alder's dedicated environment

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will host Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

contract_quote.quote: Provider will host the Customer's dedicated environment on Amazon Web Services in the Sydney region.

findings.subject: environment
findings.reason: The RFP response promises Azure hosting while the SOW commits to AWS hosting, a direct conflict on the hosting cloud that must be reconciled before signature.

findings.commitment: Real-time scoring of every outbound instant payment before release

promise_quotes.quote: Every outbound instant payment will be scored in real time before it is released, from the 1 February 2027 launch.

contract_quote.quote: Outbound instant payments below AUD 1,000 are scored in batches at hourly intervals after release.

findings.subject: payment
findings.promised_value: all outbound instant payments scored in real time regardless of amount
findings.contract_value: payments below AUD 1,000 scored in batches at hourly intervals after release, not in real time
findings.reason: The proposal promises every payment is checked in real time before release, but the incorporated Annex A only scores payments under AUD 1,000 in hourly batches after release, contradicting the 'stop it before it leaves' promise and the customer's board commitment.

findings.commitment: Real-time scoring will handle up to 750,000 payments per day by the end of the first year

promise_quotes.quote: Real-time scoring will handle up to 750,000 payments per day by the end of the first year.

findings.reason: 750,000 transactions per day exceeds the catalogue's 500,000/day limit for real-time transaction monitoring in Australia, and no exception has been approved.
